svg.title: BdREN VAULT - N-tier architecture: four tiers, one folder per app in each tier
svg.desc: Rows are the four tiers (presentation, business, data access, database); columns are the seven apps. Each cell lists the real files of that app in that tier. core/ and config/ are shared by every tier.
svg.text: N-tier architecture: four tiers, one folder per app
Rows are tiers (top-level folders), columns are apps. Each cell is a real folder, for example business/backups/. Calls go downwards only.
bold = the main file of each tier (views, services, selectors, models) · a tier only calls the tiers below it · checked by python manage.py check_architecture
database/<app>/ also holds apps.py and admin.py (Django registration). The app label never changes, so tables and migrations stay the same.
